name: Mediterranean trees (cypress, stone pine, olive, broadleaf)
license: original procedural geometry (TIMELINES Studio); materials use CC0 Poly Haven textures, see data/textures/LICENSES.json
source: procedural bpy generator tl_buildings.py / tl_nature.py (via build_assets.py)
historical_accuracy_notes: v2 (2026-11-26): trees built from 150-450 small leaf cards (procedural leaf-cluster alpha, translucency, crown-depth shading, normals bent outward) on modelled trunks and limbs: Italian cypress (narrow spindle), umbrella/stone pine (bare leaning trunk, forked limbs, flat crown), olive (2-3 gnarled stems, grey-green), broadleaf, maquis shrub, grass tuft; instanced with Geometry Nodes in scenes. Shapes are stylised from the living species; leaves are not botanically modelled.
references: Pliny the Elder, Naturalis Historia XVI (trees)
